Voter priorities like the economy, immigration, healthcare, and democracy are expected to heavily sway electoral outcomes, shaping both immediate governance and the political landscape ahead of the 2028 presidential election.

Legal actions include criminal charges and potential disciplinary measures against the officials involved in the case.

title: Haldhar Nag left school after Class 3, later won Padma Shri for his poetry

Despite this setback, his poignant poetry in the Kosli language gained national recognition, inspiring academic studies that underscore its cultural importance. Nag's inaugural poem was published in 1990, reflecting on social themes. In 2016, he was awarded the Padma Shri, marking his vital role in promoting regional literature in scholarly discussions.

title: New norms for cars from 2029: Rear-crash tests, data recorders

The requirements will come into effect from April 2027 onwards. In a notification, the ministry also made AIS-192 mandatory for Event Data Recorders (EDRs) installed in cars from Oct 2029.

title: After renaming Lake Ontario, Google CEO rejects US request to rename Atlantic Ocean

During a recent event, he mentioned contacting Google Maps regarding these renaming efforts. This follows the US administration's earlier renaming of Lake Ontario to Lake America for US users.
